items.contentSnippet:

That scaling was becoming more and more critical as I was beginning to build agentic swarms.
So I built my own alternative with Elixir and Beam. Been using it in production for almost 2 months.
It connects my agent to multiple databases, sandboxes, and APIs.
I've even migrated over my most used n8n workflows without a hiccup.

items.title: Show HN: Globus – Daily world news, placed on the globe where it happened (iOS)
items.contentSnippet:
I created Globus, to stay informed about the world.
The app was born out of frustration with how ignorant I was getting about the world outside of the media bubble. It was true when I lived in Norway, and the ignorance got to a whole other level after moving to the US.
